subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - Novamed / clarifying questions
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: James Lee <james.lee@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire initiation - Novamed / clarifying questions

Hi James —

Thanks again for the call this morning — really appreciate the context on your roadmap and the latency/cost targets you mentioned. As discussed, attaching our standard SIG (v2) to start the security review. A few clarifying notes/questions up-front to help speed the process: 

1) Scope: Will your security team need answers scoped only to our hosted SaaS (Redwood API) or also for Dedicated/Private deployments if we end up evaluating those?
2) PHI/PII: You mentioned Novamed will send de-identified PHI for testing. Can you confirm whether any PHI will be processed in-hosted SaaS (our multi-tenant environment) or if you require a Dedicated/private deployment for PHI/HIPAA workloads?
3) Timeline: What SLA do you have for returning the completed SIG? We typically see 7-14 business days for initial passes, faster if we focus on a prioritized subset.
4) Evidence: Would your team prefer copies of the latest SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) or uploaded artifacts in Drive? We can provide both.

Next steps I propose: I’ll assign Marissa (security eng liaison) on our side to coordinate evidence and clarifications. If you can confirm scope and timeline we’ll pre-fill the SIG owner fields and get you the SOC2 and related docs.

Attachment: Novamed_SIG.xlsx (blank)

Thanks —

Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0126
https://www.redwoodinference.com

--
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference for engineering teams
From: James Lee <james.lee@novamed.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@novamed.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - Novamed / clarifying questions

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the quick follow-up and for sending the SIG. A few quick answers and clarifying Qs from our side: 

- Scope: Initially we only need answers for the hosted SaaS environment. If performance looks good we may request a Dedicated evaluation later in the procurement timeline.
- PHI/PII: For the pilot we will only send de-identified patient data; however, the roadmap includes PHI in production and our security team is evaluating whether a BAA and Dedicated environment will be required.
- Timeline: Our security team aims to return an initial pass within 10 business days, but we may have follow-ups.
- Evidence: Please upload the SOC 2 Type II report and a short evidence pack to a shared Drive link — that works best for our reviewers.

Clarifying questions for your team: 
1) Is Redwood’s hosted environment covered under a SOC 2 Type II with scope that includes your API and multitenant inference runtime (i.e., the inference service and persistence layers)? If yes, can you confirm the date range for the most recent assessment?
2) Do you provide a BAA for HIPAA customers? If so, is it available ahead of contract signature (we may need an interim agreement)?
3) For GDPR/data residency — do you offer regionally isolated deployments/controls or contractual commitments for EU data?

Looping in our security mailbox for visibility — security@novamed.com.

Best,
James
Head of Integrations | Novamed Health
james.lee@novamed.com | +1 (617) 555-0199
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: James Lee <james.lee@novamed.com>, security@novamed.com
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire initiation - Novamed / clarifying questions

Hi James (and Novamed security team) —

Thanks — Marissa here from Redwood’s Security & Risk team. I’ll be your primary point of contact for the SIG and evidence exchange. Answers to your clarifying questions below, and next steps: 

1) SOC 2: Yes — our hosted API and multitenant inference runtime are covered under our SOC 2 Type II (security & availability in scope). The most recent report covers the period 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31. We are happy to provide a redacted PDF.

2) BAA/HIPAA: We do offer a BAA for customers processing PHI. We can provide an interim BAA draft for review prior to contract signature if helpful; final execution typically aligns with procurement. If you anticipate PHI in production, please flag that so we can prioritize the Dedicated/private options and BAA workflow.

3) GDPR/data residency: We support contractual commitments and region-specific deployments via Redwood Dedicated and Private. For hosted SaaS we offer contractual GDPR controls and subprocessors disclosures; for EU-data residency guarantees we generally recommend Dedicated/private deployments or a regionally isolated hosting arrangement.

Evidence & next steps: 
- I’ve uploaded the redacted SOC 2 report, encryption overview, and subprocessors list to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-novamed-security
- Request: please complete the attached Novamed_SIG.xlsx and return to me; if you prefer, we can prioritize a subset of ~25 high-risk questions for an accelerated review.
- Timeline: We’ll aim to provide initial responses to the SIG within 7 business days of receiving it back; items requiring evidence may take longer.

Attachment references (Drive): SOC2_TypeII_Redacted_2026.pdf, encryption_controls_summary.pdf, subprocessors_list.csv

If helpful I can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough with one of our engineers to go through any SIG questions live. 

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Security & Risk | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0144
